mentions.name: Signal without smartphone
mentions.description: This desktop tool helps people set up a Signal account without needing a smartphone. Built in Rust with egui, it provides a graphical interface so users can complete the setup without using the command line.
mentions.problem: Setting up a Signal account normally requires a smartphone and the CLI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Currently working on a way to help folks setup a signal account without requiring a smartphone.

It's in rust with egui, and should help folks to do that without the cli.

Not ready for prime time yet, but available at https://github.com/almet/signal-without-smartphone
